propertyDetails.description: PRIME LOCATION & TOP LOS GATOS SCHOOLS | Just blocks from Downtown Los Gatos, this rarely available corner-lot Victorian duplex offers timeless character and exceptional flexibility. Zoned for top Los Gatos schools, its ideal for owner-occupants, multi-generational living, or long-term investment. The upper unit (3 bd / 2.5 ba) is freshly updated with new carpet, designer lighting, and updated bathrooms, while maintaining its vintage charm through soaring ceilings, stained-glass accents, and a clawfoot tub. Vacant and move-in ready, its set up for an owner to live upstairs and collect rent from the lower unit to offset the mortgage. The lower unit (2 bd / 2.5 ba) has a remodeled kitchen with soft-close cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless appliances, plus two en-suites with walk-in closets (tenant occupied at market rent). Both units include private laundry and direct access to a shared backyard with lawn, dining, and lounge zones, rare this close to downtown. Enjoy 8 off-street parking spaces and room to add a garage + ADU (buyer to verify). Minutes to Downtown Los Gatos and quick access to HWY 17. Strong inspections, updated systems, and consistent maintenance deliver a turnkey opportunity with meaningful upside.
